Benny Gantz ally Benny Eisenkot wins mandate to form Israeli government

Benny Eisenkot, an ally of Benny Gantz, has received the mandate to form a government in Israel. His bloc secured the backing of 67 Members of Knesset (MKs) and won the first Knesset vote, which paves the way for shaping future legislation. This development follows the political maneuvering in Israel's parliament.
